title: A carried attempt released past the grace integrates nothing on resume
body:
The recorded-verdict precedence restores the verdict but not the collected HEAD. An attempt carried from a released one that delivered the carried work commits nothing of its own (its branch sits at the carried head), so its re-collected Collection carries no head; the resumed integrate then refuses in durableAttemptHead ('the collect of this attempt read no commit at all') and the run stops for a person with the work preserved — far better than the re-judging this tick removed, but the recorded verdict still cannot finish the attempt by itself. The fix would record the collected head beside the verdict and let durableAttemptHead read it, the way it already reads a repair decision's recorded head (recordedAttemptHead).
evidence: internal/reconcile/integrate.go:376 (durableAttemptHead's local=="" refusal); internal/reconcile/dispatch.go readRecordedVerdictFirst
